about: Tokens this app adds to APL (approved 2026-11-15). Not part of the APL design system: errors and destructive text, and data colours that are drawn but never mark UI state.

color.name: danger
color.usage: Error text and destructive text buttons only (7.6:1 on surface). Never a fill behind text, never next to a target face as a score colour.

color.name: on-danger
color.usage: Text on a danger fill (the confirm button of a destructive dialog).
